title: The 2026-10-12 comparison in benchmarks.md corrects six figures and claims the review found off
goal: kb/_self/reports/benchmarks.md reports the Haiku 5.5 low gap cell falling 5 of 5 to 4 of 5 beyond its interval; the tool-speed text attributes the cold pack's doubling to the freshness stamp as the Since section does; the plugin always-on rise is set against the spread of the 2026-10-08 and 2026-10-12 cells, not 2026-09-28's; the hook's 14 new rows beyond the router's kinds are named; the warm pack figure compares 2026-10-09 with 2026-10-12; the pool record's text names the discarded first attempt of 2026-10-12 (61.09 USD, failed pool verify (b)); the Since section names for kb-lookup-agent its start context rising 37% (about 4.0k to 5.5k) with the change behind it and the model move from Haiku 4.5 to Haiku 5.5, for partial that its comparison with 2026-09-28 spans the model move from Haiku 4.5 and Sonnet 5 to Haiku 5.5 and Sonnet 5.5, for retrieval the untagged line-in-pack share falling 97% to 93% with its cause or a noise statement

run: import sys;t=open('kb/_self/reports/benchmarks.md').read();i=t.find('What it shows: with 359 topics');s=t[i:i+1500];bad=[m for m,ok in (('tool-speed still unattributed','does not say which of the changes' not in s),('first attempt not named','61.09' in t)) if not ok];print(bad or 'ok');sys.exit(1 if bad else 0)

Merged from ST-yb55ymhx at the triage (same file, same review): the Since section lacks kb-lookup-agent and line-in-pack, three more gaps.
Premise: the three checks fail on main.
